description: A standardized public health response to an E. coli outbreak at several Calgary daycare centres three years ago resulted in fewer children developing serious health complications, a new study suggests.
title: Early detection prevented worse outcomes in Calgary E. coli outbreak at 11 daycares: study

description: CBC Sports' daily newsletter recaps Day 4 of the Paralympic Winter Games and looks at the top Canadians to watch on Wednesday.
title: Paralympic viewing guide: Mark Arendz eyes 14th career medal

description: Former CBC News host Travis Dhanraj accused the public broadcaster of trying to silence him when he challenged bias at the network and fought for diversity of opinion.
title: Former CBC News host Travis Dhanraj says he was 'pulled off the air' for fighting against bias

description: Mihail Oblacov's life hit "rock bottom essentially right out of the gate" after he was introduced to crystal meth, his lawyer says. His actions while he was in the throes of his addiction in 2024 caused the death of a stranger.
title: Regina man imprisoned for crystal meth-fuelled crime spree that ended in fatal collision

description: When the NDP's arms-control bill that seeks to end largely permit-free Canadian military exports to the U.S. is put to a vote on Wednesday, it could garner the support of more than a dozen Liberal MPs. That would be the first time some in caucus split from the government's position on legislation under Prime Minister Mark Carney.
title: Up to 16 Liberals considering support for NDP's arms-control legislation

description: Vancouver Coun. Sean Orr is suing Mayor Ken Sim for allegedly defamatory comments Sim made at an event for members of Chinese-language media in February.
title: Vancouver Coun. Sean Orr sues Mayor Ken Sim for defamation

description: First Nations leaders unveiled five items repatriated to their communities after being at the Vatican for more than a century, during a ceremony at the Canadian Museum of History in Gatineau, Que., on Tuesday.
title: IN PHOTOS | First Nations leaders unveil items repatriated from Vatican

description: The federal government will spend $228.8 million over the next three years to help Ontario workers in industries hit hard by U.S. tariffs acquire new skills and adapt to the trade war disruption.
title: Ottawa spending $229M to help tariff-hit Ontario workers obtain new skills

description: Wiarton Willie has died three years after becoming the latest woodchuck to carry on the Groundhog Day tradition begun in 1956 in the Ontario community. "Willie was a curious and charismatic groundhog who delighted both residents and visitors," the Town of South Bruce Peninsula said in announcing the sad news Tuesday.
title: Wiarton Willie, Ontario's beloved weather-prognosticating groundhog, is dead

description: A petition looking to oust Alberta Premier Danielle Smith from her seat in the legislature has failed.
title: Citizen-led recall bid against Alberta premier falls far short of threshold

description: Actors Hudson Williams and Francois Arnaud posted matching statements to their Instagram accounts on Monday night, calling out hateful comments made by fans of the hit hockey romance show.
title: Canadian Heated Rivalry stars denounce hateful comments

description: On Monday night, Canada's Shai Gilgeous-Alexander matched Wilt Chamberlain's NBA record of 126 consecutive regular-season games of 20 or more points.
title: Hamilton's Shai Gilgeous-Alexander ties NBA 20-point streak record

description: A Montreal man charged in connection with a murder plot allegedly ordered by accused drug kingpin Ryan Wedding — and said to involve a Quebec hitman known as Tupac — has pleaded not guilty in a U.S. court.
title: Montrealer charged in Ryan Wedding-linked murder plot pleads not guilty

description: The province will be taking over control of Billy Bishop airport on Toronto Island, Ontario Premier Doug Ford told reporters at a news conference on Tuesday.
title: Ford says Ontario government will take over Toronto's Billy Bishop airport

description: The family of Canadian soldier Stefan Jankowski has been reunited with a military medal that had been missing since the time of his death 2011. He’s from Windsor, Ont., and was a trooper with the Royal Canadian Dragoons, serving in Afghanistan, where he earned the medal.
title: Ontario family reunited with war medal missing since veteran died in 2011

description: The sexual assault trial of rapper and filmmaker K'naan began Tuesday at the Quebec City courthouse. He's accused of assaulting a woman in her 20s at the Hilton Quebec hotel in 2010, where he was staying while performing at the Festival d'été de Québec.
title: Accuser testifies rapper K'naan went from 'charming' to 'monster' at sexual assault trial

description: The defence began presenting its case Monday, calling several witnesses, including the businessman's former driver. The trial continues at a Toronto courthouse Tuesday.
title: Defence calls more witnesses as billionaire Frank Stronach's sexual assault trial continues

description: More than a dozen First Nations chiefs and even more band councillors and elders were at Alberta's legislature Monday, calling on Premier Danielle Smith's government to stomp out the push for the province to quit Canada.
title: First Nations chiefs go to Alberta legislature, pressure province to end separation debate

description: Environment Canada is warning of a major freezing rain storm spanning parts of Ontario, Quebec and the Atlantic provinces, which the weather agency says could lead to power outages and dangerous road conditions.
title: Major freezing rain storm could affect large swath of Eastern Canada, Environment Canada warns

description: Supports and programming for people with disabilities, seniors and African Nova Scotian and Indigenous students will be maintained, reversing the cuts that were previously announced.
title: 'We got it wrong': N.S. government reverses course on some budget cuts after outcry

description: Canadian Para nordic skiing star Natalie Wilkie has now won a medal of every colour at the Milano-Cortina Paralympics, adding bronze in the women's standing sprint classic on Tuesday in Val di Fiemme.
title: Canada's Natalie Wilkie skis to 3rd medal of Milano Cortina, earning sprint classic bronze

description: CBC News heard from 6,000 teachers and other educators across the province with a nuanced view of life in Alberta classrooms. Many worry a staffing crisis is on the horizon and express little hope for substantial change. There was a lot of anger — much of it directed at the government, some at union officials, and in a few cases, against school district leaders.
title: Strike aftermath leaves many Alberta teachers isolated, looking for new work

description: Police say officers responded to reports of gunfire directed at the U.S. consulate in downtown Toronto around 5:30 a.m. Tuesday.
title: U.S. consulate target of gunfire, no injuries reported: Toronto police

description: The parents of an Edmonton security guard killed in an armed robbery in 2012 are pushing for legislative changes that would limit parole eligibility for their son’s killer and other convicted murderers in Canada.
title: Parents of security guard killed in Edmonton robbery push for parole law changes

description: A Steinbach woman and her family don't understand why she doesn't qualify for MAID in a province that denies access far more than anywhere else in Canada.
title: Manitobans denied assisted dying at 5 times national average, federal report shows

description: The family of Nancy Grewal — a personal support worker and Sikh social media influencer who was fatally stabbed outside a LaSalle, Ont., home — is remembering her as a kind-hearted and jovial woman.
title: Sister of Sikh influencer killed outside LaSalle, Ont., home says she was ‘kind-hearted’

description: Miramichi serial killer Allan Legere has died at the age of 78. Correctional Service Canada confirmed in a release that Legere died on Monday while serving a life sentence at the Edmonton Institution in Alberta.
title: Notorious Miramichi serial killer Allan Legere dead at 78

description: The Toronto man who drove from Alberta to the small coastal community of D'Escousse, N.S., where he stole a boat last fall, told court officials he was on the run from organized crime and was headed for Morocco to seek asylum.
title: The boat was named The Getaway, but the thief didn't

description: The Canadian Coast Guard fired one of its captains arguing he "willfully" ignored a distress call about a sinking boat in cold and choppy P.E.I. waters, according to a recently posted federal labour board decision.
title: Canadian Coast Guard captain fired for 'willfully' ignoring distress call: labour board

description: Every vote counts in the Montreal-area federal riding of Terrebonne, and after the Supreme Court annulled the last results over a single uncounted ballot, it’s time for electors to head back to the polls on April 13 — potentially securing a majority for the Liberals.
title: How a byelection in Quebec could help the Liberals win a majority government

description: The opposition Liberals – and hundreds of other groups – say the Coalition Avenir Québec’s consultation process on its plan for a Quebec constitution was a failure, and it’s time to scrap the law altogether.
title: Is Quebec’s controversial constitution for the province really going to happen?

description: The cost to file a code of conduct complaint against elected officials in Niagara Falls has doubled, after councillors approved a motion for an increase.
title: Want to make a complaint about a councillor in Niagara Falls, Ont.? It will now cost you $1,000
